obernants.operator: On the eight tagged bounded domains define R by the named independent identities and inequalities. Its complement includes mismatched polynomial bases, derivative signs, diagonal coordinates, threshold signs or mass, lost merged counts, wrong variance denominator, frequency bounds excluding literal counts, wrong inclusive-value/exclusive-rank endpoints, unattainable subset objectives, loss exceeding integer budget, and dot certificates normalized by |sum| instead of sum|products|. Invalid inputs, allocation failures and budget statuses are categorical, not numerical tolerance. These tests do not exhaust R's complement or establish universal floating-point accuracy.

obernants.operator: Retain every tagged input compatible with shared coordinates and observed identities. Full polynomial coefficients under a fixed-degree basis transform have a unique converse, and known nonzero signs reconstruct l1 coordinates from magnitudes, but arbitrary finite samples do not identify functions. Threshold zeros retain intervals; moments/frequency/histogram observations lose order; objective values retain many subset masks; dot values retain many vector pairs. The bounded exhaustive subset oracle checks nonempty feasible fibers. No general inverse execution engine or composition-wide percentage bound is asserted.

CG and diagonal GD coordinates, Horner derivative roots by bisection, and golden minimizers are within absolute 1e-6 of this independent minimizer. Derivative at CG result is within 1e-9. obernants.operator: Full c0 Chebyshev [2,3,-2,1] is identically monomial [4,0,-4,4]. For 33 dyadic points -1..1 compare both evaluations and independent literal polynomial/derivative to 1e-13 absolute. Integrate Clenshaw on [-1,1], compare to analytic 16/3 within 1e-12; Simpson budget1000 depth20 tol1e-10. Coefficient conventions and interval must match. obernants.operator: For x=[-3,1,-2,0], radius3 and threshold1, simplex of abs(x) must be [2,0,1,0], l1 projection and soft-threshold both [-2,0,-1,0]. These independent KKT values exclude a shared sign/threshold bug. Three small isotonic fixtures have preserved compensated sum, monotonicity, idempotence and normal-cone inequalities against ten constant feasible vectors -3..6. These inequalities are necessary observations, not a complete global optimality proof. Thresholded zeros admit intervals of antecedents; preserve original sign for nonzero reconstruction. Costs include sort at n4, PAVA and compensated sums.
